item.question: How do different wavelengths affect polarizability in dysprosium?
item.answer: Different wavelengths affect polarizability by altering both scalar and tensorial components. In specific spectral regions, such as around 402-404 nm and 415-418 nm, these changes can create optimal conditions for repulsive potentials depending on polarization angles.
